name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
blurb: Primitive dropdown menu component from Radix UI.
description: A set of Radix UI dropdown menu primitives including root, trigger, content, items, groups, separators, checkboxes, radio groups, and submenus with keyboard and mouse support.
use_when: Building custom dropdown menus with radix-ui primitives.
avoid_when: Simple one-off menus where a ready-made dropdown suffices.
a11y: Full ARIA support from Radix UI including keyboard navigation.
